question: X is the husband of Y. Y is the sister of Z. Z is the mother of W. How is X related to W?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) X is the husband of Y.

2) Y is the sister of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ffbbd95e3a5f8734c18d19cb4510fd56583240708624522895c1b174fe9e7cd.png] 

3) Z is the mother of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32f9626606a41b2ea3c33e698419cada5493b516ef737de7d60ff2ba7c8bf5ab.png] 

Here, X is W's uncle.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
